attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado state income tax calculation. Implements flat 4.40% tax on federal taxable income. Colorado uses federal taxable income as starting point, so federal standard deduction or itemized deductions already applied. Per Colorado DOR 2025. Source: https://tax.colorado.gov/individual-income-tax-guide

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Colorado tax calculation and call sub-tables
initial_action.action_postfix:
"Colorado Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.co_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.state_tax_liability xdef
Calculate_CO_Military_Retirement_Exemption

action_details.action_postfix:
result.taxable_income get /result.co_taxable_income xdef
result.co_military_retirement_exemption get 0 gt if result.co_taxable_income get result.co_military_retirement_exemption get sub 0 max /result.co_taxable_income xdef then
result.co_taxable_income get result.co_tax_rate get mul /result.state_tax_liability xdef
result.state_tax_liability get /co_tax_before_credits xdef
"Colorado tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (CO taxable income: $" strconcat result.co_taxable_income get cvs strconcat ", Rate: 4.40%)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

Calculate_CO_EITC
"Colorado tax after credits: $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado Earned Income Tax Credit. Refundable credit equal to 35-50% of federal EITC. Minimum 35%, up to 50% based on economic growth. Expanded eligibility to age 18+ and ITIN holders. Per Colorado DOR 2025. Source: https://tax.colorado.gov/ctc-eitc

initial_action.action_postfix: "Colorado EITC Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.co_eitc_credit xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate CO EITC as 35% of federal EITC (base rate)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.federal_eitc get result.co_eitc_rate_base get mul /result.co_eitc_credit xdef
result.state_tax_liability get result.co_eitc_credit get sub /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Colorado EITC applied: $" result.co_eitc_credit get cvs strconcat " (35% of federal EITC: $" strconcat result.federal_eitc get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No federal EITC - no Colorado EITC
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.co_eitc_credit xdef "No Colorado EITC - no federal EITC claimed" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado military retirement exemption (2025). Age-based: Under 55 = $15k, 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, Colorado DOR.

initial_action.action_postfix: "CO Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_under_55 min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age < 55): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_55_to_64 min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age 55-64): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_exemption_65_plus min /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CO military retirement exemption (age 65+): $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.co_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.co_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No CO military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado pension/annuity subtraction (2025). Age-based: 55-64 = $20k, 65+ = $24k. Applies to pension and annuity income not already excluded (e.g., not military retirement which has separate exemption). Source: Colorado DOR Form DR 0104.

initial_action.action_postfix: "CO Pension/Annuity Subtraction Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.co_pension_subtraction xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.pension_profit_sharing result.co_pension_subtraction_55_to_64 min /result.co_pension_subtraction xdef
"CO pension/annuity subtraction (age 55-64): $" result.co_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Pension: $" strconcat result.pension_profit_sharing cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.pension_profit_sharing result.co_pension_subtraction_65_plus min /result.co_pension_subtraction xdef
"CO pension/annuity subtraction (age 65+): $" result.co_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Pension: $" strconcat result.pension_profit_sharing cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.co_pension_subtraction xdef "No CO pension/annuity subtraction - not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Colorado state income tax calculation (2025). Flat 4.40% rate applied to federal AGI with Colorado-specific adjustments: add state tax refunds, subtract Social Security, military retirement, and pension/annuity subtractions. Source: Colorado DOR Form DR 0104.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Colorado Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi /result.co_taxable_income xdef
result.state_tax_refund 0 gt { result.co_taxable_income result.state_tax_refund add /result.co_taxable_income xdef
"CO: Added state tax refund: $" result.state_tax_refund cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.total_social_security 0 gt { result.co_taxable_income result.total_social_security sub 0 max /result.co_taxable_income xdef
"CO: Subtracted Social Security: $" result.total_social_security cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.co_military_retirement_exemption 0 gt { result.co_taxable_income result.co_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.co_taxable_income xdef
"CO: Subtracted military retirement exemption: $" result.co_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.co_pension_subtraction 0 gt { result.co_taxable_income result.co_pension_subtraction sub 0 max /result.co_taxable_income xdef
"CO: Subtracted pension/annuity subtraction: $" result.co_pension_subtraction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.co_taxable_income result.co_tax_rate mul /result.co_tax xdef
result.co_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Colorado taxable income: $" result.co_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Colorado tax calculated (4.40%): $" result.co_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
